Drafted from US DOL WHD state tables (confidence=medium) on 2026-11-06; upgrade to primary sources pending.
minimum_wage.effective is the DOL table date (2026-11-05), not the statutory effective date.

Minors (M.G.L. c. 149 §§ 65-67): the same limits apply in school and non-school weeks, so each age band has identical school_week true/false rules. The 3 h/18 h school-week limits for under-16 come from federal law (federal.json), not found in § 65.

Minors: § 66 requires direct adult supervision on site after 8 p.m.; 16-17 may work to midnight in restaurants on nights not before a school day (encoded 11:30 p.m., stricter). Extra param key max_days_week.
